summary: Iteration 7 review: BACKEND OK (17/17 pytest pass, GET /api/ still returns metiers:100 secteurs:12). FRONTEND FAILURE: /app/frontend/src/pages/Metiers.jsx was NOT actually rewritten by main agent — the file on disk still contains the pre-iter7 implementation. All 8 frontend acceptance criteria fail because the code changes are entirely missing.

ui_bugs.issue: Filters still use horizontal scroll container (flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar) instead of flex-wrap with VISIBLE_FILTERS=7 + toggle. data-testid=filter-toggle-more is ABSENT from DOM.

All 12 sector filter buttons still display emojis directly from backend s.label (e.g. '💻 Tech & Numérique', '🏥 Santé & Social', '🏗️ BTP & Industrie', ... 12/12). No stripEmoji helper is applied. Regex /\p{Extended_Pictographic}/u matches on every filter.
The <span> above the métier name still renders m.secteur_label raw (line 77) → shows '💻 TECH & NUMÉRIQUE' etc. Emoji not stripped on tiles.

Chips render {mk} directly (line 88). If any motsCle contains an emoji it is not stripped (helper missing). Present state: no chips observed with emoji, but stripEmoji safeguard requested is not implemented.

'Forte demande' is still rendered INLINE at the BOTTOM of the card as small brick text (lines 92-96) with icon TrendingUp. Required redesign is missing: no absolute -top-2 left-4 floating badge, no Flame icon, no bg-brick pill, no uppercase font-semibold shadow-md, and no data-testid=`tension-badge-{slug}`. Query for [data-testid^=tension-badge-] returns 0 elements on the page.

The Link card wrapper has no `relative` class and no overflow-visible guard, so even if a floating -top-2 badge were added, the parent motion.div/Link would need relative positioning + overflow-visible.

issues: Horizontal scroll persists; last filter is clipped off-screen on 1920px viewport (screenshot confirmed 'Artisanat & Métiers manuels' cut). Wrap + Voir plus toggle would fix this.
